channel.title: Crates Io incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Crates Io's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: DoS Attack [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. Big thanks to Fastly for providing their CDN services and their fast response time!

item.title: crates.io slowness [resolved]
item.description: The primary source of the load appears to have been a scraper abusing our API. We have blocked the scraper and the replica database has returned to its normal heavily loaded state instead of being overloaded.

item.title: Degraded performance on crates.io [resolved]
item.description: All endpoints are now operational and available again.

item.title: Git index slow to update [resolved]
item.description: The indexes are now back to normal operations.

item.title: Git index slow to update [resolved]
item.description: The background worker has caught up, and crate publishes are now updating normally in both indexes.

item.title: Degraded performance on crates.io [resolved]
item.description: Everything continues to look stable, so we can consider this resolved.

item.title: Git index slow to update [resolved]
item.description: All published crates have been synced to the Git index, and there is now no backlog.

item.title: Sparse Index CDN Invalidations Slow to Update [resolved]
Git index slow to update [resolved]
item.description: The Git index has caught up and is now up to date.
